open scoped BigOperators

theorem defect_denote (D : ℕ) (pt negativeSeed one : S)

    (hpt : denote pt = Truncation.trunc D P)
    (hnegative : denote negativeSeed = Truncation.trunc D (C (-b)))
    (hone : denote one = Truncation.trunc D 1)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, denote (add x y) = denote x + denote y)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, denote (mul x y) = Truncation.trunc D (denote x * denote y)) :
    denote (add (mul pt negativeSeed) one) = Truncation.trunc D (1 - C b * P) := by
  rw [hadd, hmul, hpt, hnegative, SubexpTruncatedGeometric.trunc_mul_trunc,
    hone, ← Truncation.trunc_add]
  congr 1
  rw [map_neg]
  ring

theorem inverse_denote (D μ : ℕ) (zero one z cb : S)
    (add mul : S → S → S) (denote : S → A[X]) (P : A[X]) (b : A)
    (hzero : denote zero = 0) (hone : denote one = Truncation.trunc D 1)
    (hz : denote z = Truncation.trunc D (1 - C b * P))
    (hcb : denote cb = Truncation.trunc D (C b))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, denote (add x y) = denote x + denote y)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, denote (mul x y) = Truncation.trunc D (denote x * denote y)) :
    denote (mul (((fun acc => add (mul acc z) one)^[D + μ]) zero) cb) =
      SubexpResiduePolynomialInverse.inverse P b D μ := by
  rw [hmul, hcb,

  rw [mul_comm]

/-!
# Scope payloads and degree in the physical leaf order

The unary prefix and clause-family outputs have exactly the factor order
used by the semantic system. Inner scope order is the actual last-occurrence
order; only membership is used by the incidence counter.
-/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.SubexpLeafScopeOrder

open Subexp.OrderedScopeSystem Subexp.IncidencePlanSpec

variable {n ell p k B : ℕ}

def rawScopes (G : SubexpLeafData.Leaf n) (hG : (G.map ExecCNF.clauseSet).Nodup)
    (hell : 0 < ell) : List (List ℕ) :=
  Subexp.OrderedScopeSystem.rawScopes (SubexpLeafData.factors G hG)
    (SubexpLeafData.scopes G hG (ChunkPartition.indexEquiv n ell hell))

private theorem unary_values (D : ℕ) :
    ((List.finRange D).map (fun j => [j])).map (List.map Fin.val) =
      (List.range D).map List.singleton := by
  rw [List.map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_coe_finRange D, List.map_map]

theorem rawScopes_eq_stream (G : SubexpLeafData.Leaf n)
    (hG : (G.map ExecCNF.clauseSet).Nodup) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    rawScopes G hG hell =

* Out-of-range layer/expert yields `kNotResident`, never an adjacent table entry.

* `slots`      ← `ExpertCache::slots_`
* `nLayers`    ← `ExpertCache::n_layers_`
* `loRange`    ← `lo` out-param of `layer_slot_range`
* `hiRange`    ← `hi` out-param of `layer_slot_range`
* `nextFree`   ← `next_free_`
-/

namespace Strata.ExpertResidencyCache

-- § slot ranges

/-- Quota per layer: `slots_ / n_layers_`. -/
def quota (slots n : Nat) : Nat := slots / n

/-- Lower bound of layer `l`'s range. -/
def loRange (slots n l : Nat) : Nat := l * quota slots n

/-- Upper bound (exclusive) of layer `l`'s range; the last layer absorbs the remainder. -/
def hiRange (slots n l : Nat) : Nat :=
  if l = n - 1 then slots else (l + 1) * quota slots n

/-- `n` layers' quotas never exceed the slot count. -/
theorem n_quota_le (slots n : Nat) : n * quota slots n ≤ slots := by
  unfold quota
  exact Nat.mul_div_le slots n

/-- A layer's range is non-empty-or-empty but well formed: `lo ≤ hi`. -/
theorem lo_le_hi (slots n l : Nat) (hl : l < n) : loRange slots n l ≤ hiRange slots n l := by
  unfold loRange hiRange
  split_ifs with h
  · have h1 : l * quota slots n ≤ n * quota slots n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_of_lt hl)
    exact le_trans h1 (n_quota_le slots n)
  · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ l)

/-- Every layer's range stays inside the arena. -/
theorem hi_le_slots (slots n l : Nat) (hl : l < n) : hiRange slots n l ≤ slots := by
  unfold hiRange
  split_ifs with h
  · exact le_rfl
  · have h1 : (l + 1) * quota slots n ≤ n * quota slots n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hl
    exact le_trans h1 (n_quota_le slots n)

/-- Consecutive layers' ranges abut: no slot is skipped. -/
theorem hi_eq_next_lo (slots n l : Nat) (hl : l + 1 < n) :
    hiRange slots n l = loRange slots n (l + 1) := by
  unfold hiRange loRange
  have hne : l ≠ n - 1 := by omega
  rw [if_neg hne]

/-- The last layer's range ends exactly at `slots`: no slot is orphaned by the division. -/
theorem last_hi (slots n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) : hiRange slots n (n - 1) = slots := by
  unfold hiRange
  rw [if_pos rfl]

/-- The first layer's range starts at zero. -/
theorem first_lo (slots n : Nat) : loRange slots n 0 = 0 := by
  unfold loRange
  simp

/-- Ranges of distinct layers are disjoint: if `l1 < l2 < n`, then `hi l1 ≤ lo l2`. -/
theorem ranges_disjoint (slots n l1 l2 : Nat) (h12 : l1 < l2) (h2 : l2 < n) :
    hiRange slots n l1 ≤ loRange slots n l2 := by
  have hne : l1 ≠ n - 1 := by omega
  unfold hiRange loRange
  rw [if_neg hne]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h12

/-- Every non-last layer owns exactly `quota` slots. -/
theorem range_size_of_not_last (slots n l : Nat) (hl : l + 1 < n) :
    hiRange slots n l - loRange slots n l = quota slots n := by
  have h := hi_eq_next_lo slots n l hl
  have hne : l ≠ n - 1 := by omega
  unfold hiRange loRange at *
  rw [if_neg hne]
  rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
  omega

-- § admission

/-- Global admission: a slot is handed out iff the counter is below `slots`. -/
def admitGlobal (slots nextFree : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  if nextFree < slots then some nextFree else none

/-- A global admission returns an in-range slot. -/
theorem admitGlobal_lt (slots nextFree s : Nat) (h : admitGlobal slots nextFree = some s) : s < slots := by
  unfold admitGlobal at h
  split_ifs at h with hlt
  · cases h
    exact hlt

/-- A full cache refuses: it never evicts. -/
theorem admitGlobal_full (slots nextFree : Nat) (h : slots ≤ nextFree) :
    admitGlobal slots nextFree = none := by
  unfold admitGlobal
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Per-layer admission: layer `l` hands out `next` iff `next < hi(l)`. -/
def admitLayer (slots n l next : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  if next < hiRange slots n l then some next else none

/-- A per-layer admission whose cursor sits in the layer's range returns a slot in that range. -/
theorem admitLayer_in_range (slots n l next s : Nat) (hlo : loRange slots n l ≤ next)
    (h : admitLayer slots n l next = some s) :
    loRange slots n l ≤ s ∧ s < hiRange slots n l := by
  unfold admitLayer at h
  split_ifs at h with hlt
  · obtain rfl : next = s := by simpa using h
    exact ⟨hlo, hlt⟩

/-- Per-layer admission never produces a slot owned by a different layer. -/
theorem admitLayer_not_other (slots n l1 l2 next s : Nat) (h12 : l1 < l2) (h2 : l2 < n)
    (hlo : loRange slots n l1 ≤ next) (h : admitLayer slots n l1 next = some s) :
    s < loRange slots n l2 := by
  obtain ⟨_, hs⟩ := admitLayer_in_range slots n l1 next s hlo h
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hs (ranges_disjoint slots n l1 l2 h12 h2)

end Strata.ExpertResidencyCache

# MODULE: vram_memory_planner
Arithmetic planner that splits a fixed VRAM pool between fixed costs, the KV/indexer cache, and
expert-cache slots; it refuses (throws) rather than overcommit.

## Source semantics
* `state_bytes = n_gdn_layers * (S*Hv*S*4 + (d_conv-1)*C*4)`; fixed, non-evictable.
* `kv_bytes_per_token = n_qsa * (kv_elems + 2*(kv_elems/group) + keyHeads*keyDim/block)`.
* `make_plan`: if `kv + fixed > pool` it fails; else `cache_bytes = pool - kv - fixed`,
  `cache_slots = cache_bytes / blob`, and zero slots also fails.

## Form template identifiers
* `pool`        ← `vram_pool_bytes()` / `pool` argument
* `kvBytes`     ← `Plan::kv_bytes`
* `fixedBytes`  ← `dense + embd + mtp + workspace + state`
* `cacheBytes`  ← `Plan::cache_bytes`
* `cacheSlots`  ← `Plan::cache_slots`
* `blob`        ← `Costs::expert_blob`
-/

namespace Strata.VramMemoryPlanner

-- § geometry

structure Geometry where
  nLayers : Nat := 48
  nQsa : Nat := 12
  nKvHeads : Nat := 2
  headDim : Nat := 256
  kvGroup : Nat := 64
  qsaBlock : Nat := 4
  indexerKeyHeads : Nat := 1
  indexerKeyDim : Nat := 128
  ssmStateSize : Nat := 128
  ssmVHeads : Nat := 48
  ssmDConv : Nat := 4
  ssmConvChannels : Nat := 10240

def Geometry.nGdn (g : Geometry) : Nat := g.nLayers - g.nQsa

/-- GDN recurrence + conv history bytes (fp32). -/
def stateBytes (g : Geometry) : Nat :=
  g.nGdn * (g.ssmStateSize * g.ssmVHeads * g.ssmStateSize * 4 + (g.ssmDConv - 1) * g.ssmConvChannels * 4)

/-- INT8 KV + indexer keys per token. -/
def kvBytesPerToken (g : Geometry) : Nat :=
  let kvElems := 2 * g.nKvHeads * g.headDim
  let kvScales := (kvElems / g.kvGroup) * 2
  let perLayer := kvElems + kvScales
  let idxLayer := g.indexerKeyHeads * g.indexerKeyDim / g.qsaBlock
  g.nQsa * (perLayer + idxLayer)

/-- 36 GDN layers on the real artifact. -/
theorem nGdn_default : ({} : Geometry).nGdn = 36 := by decide

/-- The recurrent state is 117,669,888 B, i.e. about 85 expert slots. -/
theorem stateBytes_default : stateBytes {} = 117669888 := by decide

/-- INT8 KV plus indexer keys costs 13,056 B per token on the real artifact. -/
theorem kvBytesPerToken_default : kvBytesPerToken {} = 13056 := by decide

/-- The indexer's cached key is 32 B per token per layer (not 64 or 128). -/
theorem indexer_key_bytes_default : ({} : Geometry).indexerKeyHeads * ({} : Geometry).indexerKeyDim / ({} : Geometry).qsaBlock = 32 := by
  decide

/-- KV bytes grow linearly with context. -/
theorem kv_linear (g : Geometry) (c : Nat) :
    kvBytesPerToken g * c = c * kvBytesPerToken g := Nat.mul_comm _ _

-- § plan

structure Plan where
  kvBytes : Nat
  cacheBytes : Nat
  cacheSlots : Nat

/-- `make_plan`; `none` models `DoesNotClose`. -/
def makePlan (kvPerTok ctx fixed pool blob : Nat) : Option Plan :=

Flat blob indexing for the expert arena (`layer * n_expert + expert`), the separate per-axis bounds check

## Source semantics
* `blob(layer, expert)` is null unless `0 ≤ layer`, `0 ≤ expert < n_expert` and the flat index `< blobs`.

* The pack file holds exactly `n_layers * n_expert * BLOB` bytes with no padding.
* A quantized tensor's planes (codes, scales, offsets) are contiguous; widening fp16 scales to f32 doubles that plane.

* `flatIndex`  ← `layer * n_expert_ + expert`
* `nExpert`    ← `n_expert_`
* `blobs`      ← `blobs_`
* `BLOB`       ← `strata::kernels::cpu::BLOB` (1,382,400)
-/

namespace Strata.ExpertBlobIndexing

-- § flat index

def flatIndex (nExpert layer expert : Nat) : Nat := layer * nExpert + expert

/-- The source's guard (Nat model: negatives are already excluded). -/
def blobOk (nExpert blobs layer expert : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (expert < nExpert) && decide (flatIndex nExpert layer expert < blobs)

/-- Without the per-axis check, `(layer, n_expert)` aliases `(layer+1, 0)`. -/
theorem flat_alias (nExpert layer : Nat) :
    flatIndex nExpert layer nExpert = flatIndex nExpert (layer + 1) 0 := by
  unfold flatIndex
  rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul, Nat.add_zero, Nat.add_comm nExpert]
  omega

/-- The per-axis guard rejects the aliasing index. -/
theorem guard_rejects_overrun (nExpert blobs layer : Nat) :
    blobOk nExpert blobs layer nExpert = false := by
  unfold blobOk
  simp

/-- Within the guard, flat indexing is injective in `(layer, expert)`. -/
theorem flat_injective (nExpert l1 e1 l2 e2 : Nat) (h1 : e1 < nExpert) (h2 : e2 < nExpert)
    (h : flatIndex nExpert l1 e1 = flatIndex nExpert l2 e2) : l1 = l2 ∧ e1 = e2 := by
  unfold flatIndex at h
  have hl : l1 = l2 := by
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy l1 l2 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso
      have : (l1 + 1) * nExpert ≤ l2 * nExpert := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hlt
      rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul] at this
      omega
    · exact heq
    · exfalso
      have : (l2 + 1) * nExpert ≤ l1 * nExpert := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hgt
      rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul] at this
      omega
  subst hl
  exact ⟨rfl, by omega⟩

    (h : blobOk nExpert blobs layer expert = true) :
    flatIndex nExpert layer expert * blobBytes + blobBytes ≤ blobs * blobBytes := by
  unfold blobOk at h
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  obtain ⟨_, hi⟩ := h
  have h1 : (flatIndex nExpert layer expert + 1) * blobBytes ≤ blobs * blobBytes :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
  rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul] at h1
  exact h1
